title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams.
  • Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams
  • Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities
  • Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.
  • Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
  • 3+ years of relevant technology experience
  • 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience.
  • Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure.
  • Strong background in software engineering
  • Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services
  • Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA
  • Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Experience in developing Azure Policies.
  • Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform
  • Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system
  • Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting.
  • Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively.
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others
  • Strong verbal and writing skills
  • Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Desired Qualifications

  • Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure

Skills

Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Engenheiro Full Stack
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com FastAPI
  • Consumo de dados do Snowflake
  • Testes, validações e integração com CI/CD
  • Criação de dashboards em React com gráficos e tabelas
  • Consumo de APIs e gerenciamento de estado


O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Forte experiência em React (React Query, Material UI)
  • Experiência com FastAPI ou similar
  • JavaScript/TypeScript sólido
  • Conhecimento básico de SQL


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
O Agente de Registro é o profissional responsável por atuar no processo de emissão de certificados digitais, garantindo a validação, segurança e conformidade dos procedimentos exigidos pela legislação e pelas entidades certificadoras. Sua função principal é verificar a autenticidade dos documentos apresentados, realizar atendimentos presenciais ou remotos, além de coletar dados biométricos e emitir o certificado digital.

Descrição de Cargo:

  • Realizar atendimento presencial ao cliente na unidade da instituição, com data e hora previamente agendadas, garantindo um serviço personalizado e eficiente.
  • Realizar atendimento remoto via videoconferência, assegurando a mesma qualidade de suporte oferecida no atendimento presencial.
  • Realizar atendimento in loco, quando necessário, deslocando-se até o local do cliente para oferecer suporte presencial, conforme a demanda e necessidade do cliente.
  • Tirar dúvidas e prestar orientações detalhadas sobre a usabilidade do certificado digital, proporcionando uma experiência de uso clara e facilitada.
  • Realizar a conferência e verificar a autenticidade e veracidade dos documentos apresentados, assegurando que estejam em conformidade com as exigências legais e regulamentares.
  • Lançar os dados do cliente no sistema interno, garantindo que todas as informações estejam corretas e devidamente registradas, seguindo os padrões de segurança e confidencialidade.
  • Coletar a biometria facial e digital do cliente de forma online, utilizando ferramentas tecnológicas que assegurem a precisão e segurança dos dados biométricos.
  • Realizar a emissão do certificado digital, garantindo que todos os procedimentos tenham sido devidamente cumpridos, e que o cliente receba o certificado de forma rápida e segura.
  • Orientar o cliente sobre o processo de download (baixa) do certificado digital, explicando sua importância, prazos de validade, e as melhores práticas para mantê-lo seguro e acessível.
  • Realizar o atendimento e fornecer suporte contínuo aos clientes e contadores, utilizando todos os meios de comunicação oferecidos pela empresa, como telefone, e-mail, chat ou outros, garantindo a solução de dúvidas e problemas relacionados ao certificado digital
  • Viajar ocasionalmente para treinar novos colaboradores, compartilhar boas práticas e padrões operacionais, ou ate mesmo para cobrir férias e ausências em diferentes unidades ou na sede da instituição, conforme a necessidade de alocação. Sendo que esta alocação é diferente da sua alocação rotineira.


Salário:

  • R$ 2.043,39

Benefícios:

* Vale alimentação/refeição de R$ 28,00 ao dia;

* Vale Saúde no valor de R$ 320,00 no mês;

* Plano Odontológico Dental Uni Elite;

* Convênio com farmácia;

* Gympass;

* Subsídio dê duas sessões de psicoterapia no espaço Existir;

* Convênio com instituições de ensino;

* Campanhas de comemoração para os colaboradores.

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: DevOps Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you'll need to have

  • Proven experience with Azure Databricks or Azure Data Factory.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience in creating and maintaining Helm Charts.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD).
  • Scripting knowledge in Bash, Python, or equivalent.
  • Experience in monitoring and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • English proficiency (minimum B2 level).
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


Also good to have:

  • Experience with Service Mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud security.
  • Familiarity with full-stack observability.
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD) are valued.


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams.
  • Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams
  • Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities
  • Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.
  • Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
  • 3+ years of relevant technology experience
  • 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience.
  • Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure.
  • Strong background in software engineering
  • Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services
  • Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA
  • Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Experience in developing Azure Policies.
  • Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform
  • Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system
  • Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting.
  • Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively.
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others
  • Strong verbal and writing skills
  • Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Desired Qualifications

  • Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure

Skills

Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

description:
Especializada em processos biotecnológicos, a Biorigin é guiada por criatividade, aprendizado contínuo e um forte compromisso com o futuro. Há mais de 20 anos, desenvolvemos ingredientes naturais que contribuem para a qualidade da alimentação humana e animal, promovendo sabor, nutrição e bem-estar.

#VempraBiorigin

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team working on a large-scale, enterprise-grade, multi-tenant web platform.

In this role, you will build and maintain a sophisticated web application using modern technologies, contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, scalability, code quality, and exceptional user experience .



Technical Stack - Core Technologies


  • Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14 (Pages Router), TypeScript
  • Styling: Linaria (CSS-in-JS)
  • State Management: React Context API
  • Backend/API: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
  • Headless CMS: Contentstack
  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress (E2E)
  • Build Tools: Webpack 5, Babel, Yarn 4 (Workspaces)

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, Route53, ALB)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring: Elastic APM
  • Caching: Redis
  • Analytics: mParticle, Adobe Target


Key Responsibilities - Development


  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Build and maintain reusable, well-typed component libraries with comprehensive test coverage
  • Integrate and manage content delivery workflows using a headless CMS


Code Quality & Best Practices


  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established standards (strict TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint)
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive, high-quality feedback
  • Follow accessibility standards and best practices in semantic HTML


Collaboration


  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineering teams
  • Mentor junior engineers and lead technical knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical design discussions
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to architectural decision records


Required Qualifications - Experience


  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • 2+ years working with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks
  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS solutions (Linaria, Styled Components, or similar)
  • Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms


Technical Skills


  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript with strict typing
  • Strong understanding of React hooks, Context API, and component lifecycle
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Webpack and Babel
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Proficiency with Git and command-line workflows
  • Strong testing mindset with experience in Jest, React Testing Library, and E2E testing


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to code quality
  • Ability to balance technical debt and feature delivery in a fast-paced environment


Nice to Have


  • Experience in regulated or enterprise-scale platforms
  • Knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience building design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6)
  • Experience using Storybook for component documentation
  • Knowledge of analytics platforms (mParticle, Adobe)
  • Experience with blue-green deployments
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards

title: Account Executive Brazil
description:
Localização


Brasil (remoto)

Disponibilidade para reuniões presenciais estratégicas


Sobre a Cybervision


A Cybervision é uma plataforma moderna de PAM (Privileged Access Management), criada para empresas que precisam de segurança imediata, visibilidade total e controle real sobre acessos privilegiados. Nosso foco é entregar valor rápido, com implantação ágil, monitoramento ativo e abordagem orientada a risco e negócio.


 Responsabilidades

• Atuar na abertura de novos clientes no mercado brasileiro, com foco em médias e grandes empresas

• Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas: prospecção, diagnóstico, apresentação, negociação e fechamento

• Identificar dores reais relacionadas a acessos privilegiados, identidade, compliance e risco operacional

• Trabalhar de forma consultiva, traduzindo conceitos técnicos de cibersegurança em valor de negócio

• Atuar em conjunto com times de pré-vendas e engenharia para construção de propostas técnicas e comerciais

• Desenvolver e manter um pipeline previsível, com foco em resultados e recorrência

• Apoiar a construção da estratégia de entrada e posicionamento da Cybervision no Brasil

• Manter relacionamento próximo com decisores (CIO, CISO, CTO, Segurança, Infra e Risco)


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência comprovada como Account Executive ou Hunter B2B em tecnologia ou cibersegurança

• Domínio de conceitos de cibersegurança, especialmente:

• PAM (Privileged Access Management)

• IAM / Identity

• Acesso remoto seguro

• Compliance (ISO 27001, LGPD, SOX – diferencial)

• Capacidade de conduzir vendas complexas e consultivas

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos e executivos

• Perfil hunter, orientado a metas e crescimento

• Autonomia, disciplina e visão estratégica de mercado

• Inglês


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

• Experiência com soluções de PAM, ZTNA, Zero Trust etc…

• Carteira ativa de contatos em TI, Segurança da Informação ou Infraestrutura

• Vivência em vendas de SaaS B2B



 O que oferecemos

• Atuação em um produto estratégico e de alto valor no mercado de cibersegurança

• Autonomia real para construir mercado e gerar impacto

• Modelo de remuneração competitivo (fixo + variável)

• Possibilidade de crescimento junto com a expansão da Cybervision no Brasil

• Contato direto com liderança e participação ativa na estratégia da empresa



Perfil que buscamos


  • Buscamos alguém que entenda segurança de verdade, saiba vender valor (não apenas produto) e queira fazer parte da construção de uma nova referência em PAM no Brasil.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for a Business Analyst to join their team. This person will be working on a data connector project from Veeva Quality to Veeva RIM. They will be responsible for meeting with the business stakeholders across Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing & Supply Chain to understand business requirements and write user documents. They will be acting as a liaison between the business and the technical Veeva teams. They will also be interfacing with the validation team to understand the records in the system, write the data plan and relay that to the technical team. This resource must have prior pharma experience and be comfortable speaking with both technical and business teams. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 5-7 Years of Experience as a Business Analyst - Pharma and Manufacturing experience - Knowledge of supply chain, quality and manufacturing - 1-2 years of Veeva Quality knowledge - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Knowledge of SAP ERP Systems

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • - Regulatory experience - Veeva RIM experience


Compensation :

$17-$19/ hr USD

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for a Business Analyst to join their team. This person will be working on a data connector project from Veeva Quality to Veeva RIM. They will be responsible for meeting with the business stakeholders across Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing & Supply Chain to understand business requirements and write user documents. They will be acting as a liaison between the business and the technical Veeva teams. They will also be interfacing with the validation team to understand the records in the system, write the data plan and relay that to the technical team. This resource must have prior pharma experience and be comfortable speaking with both technical and business teams. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 5-7 Years of Experience as a Business Analyst - Pharma and Manufacturing experience - Knowledge of supply chain, quality and manufacturing - 1-2 years of Veeva Quality knowledge - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Knowledge of SAP ERP Systems

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • - Regulatory experience - Veeva RIM experience


Compensation :

$17-$19/ hr USD

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
About the Company

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Java developer with strong backend fundamentals and hands-on experience building scalable, reactive systems, ideally in payments or fintech environments.

This role focuses on building and maintaining a high-performance, reactive mid-tier service that powers seamless payment experiences for millions of users.


Responsibilities

  • Develop & Maintain: Design, code, and maintain scalable services within a distributed reactive architecture.
  • Debug & Optimize: Troubleshoot production incidents and optimize JVM memory management and application throughput.
  • Testing & Compliance: Ensure code quality through rigorous testing and adhere to strict PCI compliance security standards.
  • Collaborate: Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and daily stand-ups in English.


Technical Qualifications

  • Core Concepts: Strong grasp of OOP, Design Patterns, and SOLID principles.
  • Functional Programming: Proficiency with functional concepts (Lambdas, Streams, Optionals) and reactive programming models.
  • Concurrency: Experience dealing with race conditions, deadlocks, and thread safety in a multi-threaded environment.
  • API Development: Strong experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Arquitetura e Boas Práticas

* Aplicação de design patterns e boas práticas voltadas a arquiteturas escaláveis, performáticas e sustentáveis.

* Experiência com filas JMS.

* Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs REST, com foco em desempenho, segurança e padronização.

* Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise e monitoramento de logs, com preferência por Graylog.

Frontend e Desenvolvimento Web

* Conhecimento em Angular 2+ e arquitetura de Microfrontend, para construção de aplicações modulares e escaláveis.

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for a Business Analyst to join their team. This person will be working on a data connector project from Veeva Quality to Veeva RIM. They will be responsible for meeting with the business stakeholders across Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing & Supply Chain to understand business requirements and write user documents. They will be acting as a liaison between the business and the technical Veeva teams. They will also be interfacing with the validation team to understand the records in the system, write the data plan and relay that to the technical team. This resource must have prior pharma experience and be comfortable speaking with both technical and business teams. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 5-7 Years of Experience as a Business Analyst - Pharma and Manufacturing experience - Knowledge of supply chain, quality and manufacturing - 1-2 years of Veeva Quality knowledge - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Knowledge of SAP ERP Systems

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • - Regulatory experience - Veeva RIM experience


Compensation :

$17-$19/ hr USD

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
About the Company

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Java developer with strong backend fundamentals and hands-on experience building scalable, reactive systems, ideally in payments or fintech environments.

This role focuses on building and maintaining a high-performance, reactive mid-tier service that powers seamless payment experiences for millions of users.


Responsibilities

  • Develop & Maintain: Design, code, and maintain scalable services within a distributed reactive architecture.
  • Debug & Optimize: Troubleshoot production incidents and optimize JVM memory management and application throughput.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
About the Company

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Java developer with strong backend fundamentals and hands-on experience building scalable, reactive systems, ideally in payments or fintech environments.

This role focuses on building and maintaining a high-performance, reactive mid-tier service that powers seamless payment experiences for millions of users.


Responsibilities

  • Develop & Maintain: Design, code, and maintain scalable services within a distributed reactive architecture.
  • Debug & Optimize: Troubleshoot production incidents and optimize JVM memory management and application throughput.
  • Testing & Compliance: Ensure code quality through rigorous testing and adhere to strict PCI compliance security standards.
  • Collaborate: Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and daily stand-ups in English.


Technical Qualifications

  • Core Concepts: Strong grasp of OOP, Design Patterns, and SOLID principles.
  • Functional Programming: Proficiency with functional concepts (Lambdas, Streams, Optionals) and reactive programming models.
  • Concurrency: Experience dealing with race conditions, deadlocks, and thread safety in a multi-threaded environment.
  • API Development: Strong experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for a Business Analyst to join their team. This person will be working on a data connector project from Veeva Quality to Veeva RIM. They will be responsible for meeting with the business stakeholders across Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing & Supply Chain to understand business requirements and write user documents. They will be acting as a liaison between the business and the technical Veeva teams. They will also be interfacing with the validation team to understand the records in the system, write the data plan and relay that to the technical team. This resource must have prior pharma experience and be comfortable speaking with both technical and business teams. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 5-7 Years of Experience as a Business Analyst - Pharma and Manufacturing experience - Knowledge of supply chain, quality and manufacturing - 1-2 years of Veeva Quality knowledge - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Knowledge of SAP ERP Systems

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • - Regulatory experience - Veeva RIM experience


Compensation :

$17-$19/ hr USD

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Recruiter Assistant - Fluent in English
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remote


At Blue Dot BPO , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performance executive teams at U.S.-based companies. We are looking for a Recruiter Assistant with excellent English communication skills, strong organization, and a proactive mindset to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This is a fully remote role focused on the U.S. market, offering daily exposure to global teams and a clear growth path for those who want to build a career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$3,500
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S.-based recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (executive recruiting, leadership, or management)
  • International networking and a multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the client’s U.S.-based recruiting team in sourcing and pre-qualifying candidates
  • Conduct initial screenings via phone calls, emails, and messages
  • Keep databases updated (job boards and ATS)
  • Write and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and support communication flow between candidates and recruiters
  • Assist with administrative tasks related to recruitment operations and team organization


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1), strong written and spoken communication required
  • Highly organized, focused, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS platforms
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments with tight deadlines


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors | i5 / i7 processor (or equivalent) | 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone and a quiet workspace


Build Your Career in Recruitment

If you want to work directly with U.S. teams, gain valuable recruiting experience, and grow fast in a structured and performance-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

  • Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Customer Science Team)
  • Team Focus: Marketing and Sales decision-making; transforming customer behavior into measurable objectives (acquisition, conversion, retention, revenue optimization).
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Research, design, and develop ML, statistical, and causal models for Marketing/Sales (Propensity, Uplift, Attribution, Forecasting).
  • Translate business problems into objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Design feature representations for customer behavior and lifecycle dynamics.
  • Design/analyze experiments (A/B, A/A, geo tests, incrementality, diff-in-diff).
  • Build evaluation frameworks aligned to business outcomes (ROI, CAC, GMV/LTV).
  • Partner with Marketing/Sales to define success metrics and decision thresholds.
  • Own end-to-end ML lifecycle (data acquisition to monitoring).
  • Develop scalable code/services integrating with CRM and marketing platforms.
  • Communicate insights and business implications to stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior scientists and help establish Customer Science best practices.
  • Requirements: ( Computer Vision and emphasizes Causal Inference).




Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Data Annotator (Brazil/Portuguese)
description:
Job Title: Localization Specialist – Brazil & Portuguese

Location: Remote - Brazil

Employment Type: Contract - 6 months

USD $4 per hour


About the Role:

Morpheus are working with a leader in global tech. We’re looking for a skilled Localization Specialist fluent in Portuguese and English to bring our global content to life. You’ll adapt marketing materials, websites, and product content for cultural relevance, linguistic accuracy, and brand consistency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Translate and localize content between Portuguese and English.
  • Edit and proofread translations for clarity and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and design teams to maintain tone and style.
  • Perform linguistic quality checks and maintain glossaries/style guides.
  • Work with localization tools and manage deadlines efficiently.


Requirements:

  • Native or near-native Portuguese and UK English proficiency.
  • Experience in translation, localization, or related fields.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and collaborative.


Why Join Us:

  • Work on global projects with impact.
  • Flexible hours and remote options.
  • Professional growth in a dynamic, international team .

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for a Business Analyst to join their team. This person will be working on a data connector project from Veeva Quality to Veeva RIM. They will be responsible for meeting with the business stakeholders across Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing & Supply Chain to understand business requirements and write user documents. They will be acting as a liaison between the business and the technical Veeva teams. They will also be interfacing with the validation team to understand the records in the system, write the data plan and relay that to the technical team. This resource must have prior pharma experience and be comfortable speaking with both technical and business teams. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 5-7 Years of Experience as a Business Analyst - Pharma and Manufacturing experience - Knowledge of supply chain, quality and manufacturing - 1-2 years of Veeva Quality knowledge - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Knowledge of SAP ERP Systems

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • - Regulatory experience - Veeva RIM experience


Compensation :

$17-$19/ hr USD

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

  • Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Customer Science Team)
  • Team Focus: Marketing and Sales decision-making; transforming customer behavior into measurable objectives (acquisition, conversion, retention, revenue optimization).
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Research, design, and develop ML, statistical, and causal models for Marketing/Sales (Propensity, Uplift, Attribution, Forecasting).
  • Translate business problems into objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Design feature representations for customer behavior and lifecycle dynamics.
  • Design/analyze experiments (A/B, A/A, geo tests, incrementality, diff-in-diff).
  • Build evaluation frameworks aligned to business outcomes (ROI, CAC, GMV/LTV).
  • Partner with Marketing/Sales to define success metrics and decision thresholds.
  • Own end-to-end ML lifecycle (data acquisition to monitoring).
  • Develop scalable code/services integrating with CRM and marketing platforms.
  • Communicate insights and business implications to stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior scientists and help establish Customer Science best practices.
  • Requirements: ( Computer Vision and emphasizes Causal Inference).




Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Angio/XR Clinical Application Specialist
description:
Job Responsibilities:

  • Make training plans and timely complete the clinical application training of Angio and other XR products in the area under responsibility;
  • Discover and solve customer’s clinical problems in time, improve customer satisfaction, and establish long-term customer relationships;
  • Collect customer feedback and excellent clinical images/cases, and summarize them to support product sales and new product research;
  • Assist in establishing regional expert resources, maintain expert relations, and support customers to carry out clinical scientific research;
  • Responsible for the establishment and maintenance of reference hospitals in the responsible region, and responsible for the reception of reference hospitals’ visiting;
  • Assist the sales and marketing team to achieve the company's sales targets and business growth by providing pre-sales/after-sales product/application demonstration support, as well as assisting in organizing various promotions and exhibitions.
  • Other tasks assigned by supervisors.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or above major in medical imaging diagnosis, medical imaging technology, or related field;
  • 5+ years of experience as a radiographer or radiologist in the healthcare industry, or 5+ years of experience as an application specialist in one specific modality field, familiar with Angio and other XR products, technology, and operation knowledge;
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and persuasion skills; good customer service awareness;
  • Excellent teamwork ability, enjoy working with people, and committed to providing excellent customer satisfaction;
  • Strong sense of responsibility, strong ability to work under pressure, adaptable to frequent business travel;
  • Proficient in English listening, speaking, reading, and writing;

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
About the Company

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Java developer with strong backend fundamentals and hands-on experience building scalable, reactive systems, ideally in payments or fintech environments.

This role focuses on building and maintaining a high-performance, reactive mid-tier service that powers seamless payment experiences for millions of users.


Responsibilities

  • Develop & Maintain: Design, code, and maintain scalable services within a distributed reactive architecture.
  • Debug & Optimize: Troubleshoot production incidents and optimize JVM memory management and application throughput.
  • Testing & Compliance: Ensure code quality through rigorous testing and adhere to strict PCI compliance security standards.
  • Collaborate: Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and daily stand-ups in English.

  • Core Concepts: Strong grasp of OOP, Design Patterns, and SOLID principles.

description:

title: Recruiter Assistant - Fluent in English
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remote


At Blue Dot BPO , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performance executive teams at U.S.-based companies. We are looking for a Recruiter Assistant with excellent English communication skills, strong organization, and a proactive mindset to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This is a fully remote role focused on the U.S. market, offering daily exposure to global teams and a clear growth path for those who want to build a career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$3,500
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S.-based recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (executive recruiting, leadership, or management)
  • International networking and a multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the client’s U.S.-based recruiting team in sourcing and pre-qualifying candidates
  • Conduct initial screenings via phone calls, emails, and messages
  • Keep databases updated (job boards and ATS)
  • Write and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and support communication flow between candidates and recruiters
  • Assist with administrative tasks related to recruitment operations and team organization


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1), strong written and spoken communication required
  • Highly organized, focused, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS platforms
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments with tight deadlines


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors | i5 / i7 processor (or equivalent) | 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone and a quiet workspace


Build Your Career in Recruitment

If you want to work directly with U.S. teams, gain valuable recruiting experience, and grow fast in a structured and performance-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for a Business Analyst to join their team. This person will be working on a data connector project from Veeva Quality to Veeva RIM. They will be responsible for meeting with the business stakeholders across Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing & Supply Chain to understand business requirements and write user documents. They will be acting as a liaison between the business and the technical Veeva teams. They will also be interfacing with the validation team to understand the records in the system, write the data plan and relay that to the technical team. This resource must have prior pharma experience and be comfortable speaking with both technical and business teams. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 5-7 Years of Experience as a Business Analyst - Pharma and Manufacturing experience - Knowledge of supply chain, quality and manufacturing - 1-2 years of Veeva Quality knowledge - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Knowledge of SAP ERP Systems

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • - Regulatory experience - Veeva RIM experience


Compensation :

$17-$19/ hr USD

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

  • Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Customer Science Team)
  • Team Focus: Marketing and Sales decision-making; transforming customer behavior into measurable objectives (acquisition, conversion, retention, revenue optimization).
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Research, design, and develop ML, statistical, and causal models for Marketing/Sales (Propensity, Uplift, Attribution, Forecasting).
  • Translate business problems into objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Design feature representations for customer behavior and lifecycle dynamics.
  • Design/analyze experiments (A/B, A/A, geo tests, incrementality, diff-in-diff).
  • Build evaluation frameworks aligned to business outcomes (ROI, CAC, GMV/LTV).
  • Partner with Marketing/Sales to define success metrics and decision thresholds.
  • Own end-to-end ML lifecycle (data acquisition to monitoring).
  • Develop scalable code/services integrating with CRM and marketing platforms.
  • Communicate insights and business implications to stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior scientists and help establish Customer Science best practices.
  • Requirements: ( Computer Vision and emphasizes Causal Inference).




Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Vendedor Interno (Carteira & Cross Selling)
description:
Sobre a vaga


Buscamos um(a) Vendedor(a) Interno(a) com perfil consultivo, analítico e orientado a resultado, para atuar no desenvolvimento da carteira ativa de clientes, com foco em cross selling, upsell e expansão de receita. Esse profissional será responsável por identificar novas oportunidades dentro da base, entender profundamente a operação do cliente e conectar necessidades aos nossos produtos e soluções.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira ativa de clientes;
  • Identificar oportunidades de cross selling e upsell dentro da base;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo a operação, dores e objetivos do cliente;
  • Apresentar soluções, produtos e módulos adicionais de forma clara e estratégica;
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais, desde a abordagem até o fechamento;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais e apoiar a formalização de contratos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com CS, Suporte, Pré-Vendas e Produto;
  • Registrar e acompanhar oportunidades no CRM;
  • Garantir previsibilidade de pipeline, forecast e atingimento de metas;
  • Atuar na retenção e expansão de receita (Net Revenue Retention).


Requisitos


  • Experiência prévia como Vendedor Interno, Vendedor de Carteira ou Inside Sales;
  • Vivência com cross selling e upsell em carteira ativa;
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões comerciais remotas;
  • Organização, disciplina e foco em metas;
  • Familiaridade com CRM (Pipedrive, Salesforce, HubSpot ou similar).


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com software SaaS;
  • Conhecimento em logística, supply chain, TMS, WMS, Roteirização ou ERPs;
  • Atuação prévia integrada com times de Customer Success;
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados;
  • Experiência com contratos, aditivos e renovações. Perfil comportamental
  • Forte senso de dono e responsabilidade;
  • Mentalidade de crescimento e aprendizado contínuo;
  • Proatividade e autonomia;
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão;
  • Capacidade de criar relacionamento de longo prazo com clientes;
  • Alta orientação a resultado e performance.


Modelo de trabalho


  • Modelo: Interno e Híbrido;
  • Atuação focada em base ativa de clientes;
  • Interface constante com CS, Produto e Pré-Vendas.


O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo + comissão agressiva por expansão de carteira;
  • Plano de carreira claro e estruturado;
  • Ambiente de alta performance e crescimento acelerado;
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos e contas relevantes;
  • Aprendizado contínuo em tecnologia e vendas B2B

title: Especialista de Projetos
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Executar os projetos da área garantindo o adequado levantamento de requisitos de demandas, classificação, planejamento e controle a fim de executar a entrega das mesmas de acordo com as definições de segurança.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Liderança e Execução: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de projetos, desde a iniciação e planejamento até a execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento.
  • Planejamento: Elaborar cronogramas detalhados, definir escopo, identificar riscos e planejar recursos (equipe, orçamento, materiais).
  • Comunicação: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, garantindo a comunicação fluida entre stakeholders, equipes técnicas e áreas de negócio.
  • Monitoramento: Realizar o acompanhamento do progresso dos projetos, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas (turn-around).
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Gerenciar solicitações de mudança de escopo, avaliando seu impacto e garantindo a aprovação e documentação adequadas.
  • Metodologia: Aplicar as melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (tradicionais, ágeis ou híbridas), mantendo a documentação e artefatos de projeto atualizados.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Contribuir para a evolução dos processos e ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos da empresa.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 7 anos) na gestão de projetos de TI e/ou Negócios.
  • Conhecimento avançado em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (ex: PMI/PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e resolução de conflitos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.
  • Experiência comprovada ou conhecimento no ERP TOTVS Protheus.(Técnico ou Projetos)
  • Certificação PMP, CSM, ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em projetos de implantação, migração ou otimização de sistemas ERP (especialmente Protheus).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex: MS Project, Jira, Trello, Asana).


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams.
  • Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams
  • Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities
  • Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.
  • Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
  • 3+ years of relevant technology experience
  • 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience.
  • Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure.
  • Strong background in software engineering
  • Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services
  • Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA
  • Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Experience in developing Azure Policies.
  • Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform
  • Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system
  • Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting.
  • Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively.
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others
  • Strong verbal and writing skills
  • Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Desired Qualifications

  • Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure

Skills

Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD
